entityQuestion.label: How are you registered? *
entityQuestion.help: This determines what Stripe (our payment partner) needs to verify you and route your payouts correctly.

individual.title: Sole trader / freelancer
individual.desc: No registered company — you trade under your own name.

company.title: Registered company
company.desc: You have a KvK (Chamber of Commerce) registration.

payoutForm.representativeLabel: The person managing this account (usually you)

companyLegalName.label: Legal company name *
companyLegalName.help: The registered name on your KvK extract — may differ from your shop's display name.

kvkNumber.label: KvK number *
kvkNumber.help: Your 8-digit Chamber of Commerce number. Find it on your KvK extract or at kvk.nl/zoeken.

vatNumber.label: VAT number
vatNumber.help: Starts with NL, ends in B + 2 digits. On your KvK extract or tax correspondence. Leave blank if VAT-exempt.

legalName.label: Legal full name *
legalName.help: Your name exactly as it appears on your ID document — not a nickname or trade name.

dob.label: Date of birth *
dob.help: Used only for identity verification with our payment partner, Stripe. Never shown publicly.

nationality.label: Nationality
nationality.help: As shown on your ID document.

addressSection.help: Where you're registered to live — must match your ID document, not your shop's address.

bankHolder.label: Account holder name *
bankHolder.help: Must match the legal name above exactly, or Stripe will reject the account.

iban.label: IBAN *
iban.help: Your business or personal bank account. We never store the full number — only Stripe does.

ibanStatus.verified: Verified ✓ — click to enter a different account

errors.stripeNotConfigured: Secure payments are not configured right now — try again shortly.
errors.ibanVerificationFailed: That IBAN could not be verified.

payoutForm.payoutNote: 💡 That's everything we need. After approval, you'll complete one last step directly with Stripe — a photo of your ID — and everything else here will already be filled in for you.
